issues.description: The problem statement / UML requires addGuestStudents(int, String) (an int and a reason String), but the solution implementation defines addGuestStudents(int) with only a single int parameter. This parameter mismatch means the solution does not implement the method signature students are asked to create, causing confusion or failing tests that expect the two-parameter version.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the implementation match the specification: change the solution's addGuestStudents method signature to addGuestStudents(int numberOfNewGuestStudents, String reason) and handle the reason appropriately (e.g., update numberOfGuestStudents and optionally log or store the reason). Alternatively, if the second parameter was intentionally omitted, update the problem statement and UML to specify addGuestStudents(int) to keep artifacts consistent.
